mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_region_grant (region_type, region_id, user_id, grant_role, leader_user_id, granted_by) VALUES (#{regionType}, #{regionId}, #{userId}, #{grantRole}, #{leaderUserId}, #{grantedBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cage_region_grant WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND grant_role = #{grantRole}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cage_region_grant WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY grant_role ASC, region_type ASC, region_id ASC
SELECT * FROM cage_region_grant ORDER BY user_id ASC, grant_role ASC, region_type ASC, region_id ASC

SELECT g.user_id AS memberUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.name, ''), g.user_id) AS memberName, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.staff_id, ''), g.user_id) AS memberAccountId, COUNT(*) AS regionCount FROM cage_region_grant g LEFT JOIN personnel p ON p.id = g.user_id WHERE g.leader_user_id = #{leaderUserId} AND g.grant_role = 'MEMBER' GROUP BY g.user_id, p.name, p.staff_id ORDER BY memberName ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cage_region_grant WHERE leader_user_id = #{leaderUserId} AND grant_role = 'MEMBER'
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS personnelId, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.staff_id, ''), NULLIF(p.aro_user_id, ''), CAST(p.id AS CHAR)) AS accountId, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.name, ''), CAST(p.id AS CHAR)) AS name, COALESCE(p.job_number, '') AS jobNumber, MAX(lp.name) AS boundLeaderName FROM personnel p JOIN person_identity pi ON pi.user_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CAST(p.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci JOIN person_identity_tag t ON t.id = pi.tag_id AND t.code = #{identityCode} AND t.active = 1 LEFT JOIN cage_region_grant g ON g.user_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CAST(p.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND g.grant_role = 'MEMBER' LEFT JOIN personnel lp ON lp.id = g.leader_user_id GROUP BY p.id, p.staff_id, p.aro_user_id, p.name, p.job_number ORDER BY name ASC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.name, ''), g.user_id) AS memberName, COALESCE(NULLIF(lp.name, ''), g.leader_user_id) AS leaderName FROM cage_region_grant g LEFT JOIN personnel p ON p.id = g.user_id LEFT JOIN personnel lp ON lp.id = g.leader_user_id WHERE g.grant_role = 'MEMBER' AND (g.leader_user_id IS NULL OR g.leader_user_id != #{exceptLeaderUserId}) AND g.user_id IN #{u}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.staff_id, ''), NULLIF(p.aro_user_id, ''), g.user_id) AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.name, ''), g.user_id) AS name, p.staff_id AS staffId, g.user_id AS personnelId, COUNT(*) AS scopeCount FROM cage_region_grant g LEFT JOIN personnel p ON p.id = g.user_id WHERE g.grant_role = #{grantRole} GROUP BY g.user_id, p.name, p.staff_id, p.aro_user_id ORDER BY name ASC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.staff_id, ''), NULLIF(p.aro_user_id, ''), g.user_id) AS reviewerUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.name, ''), g.user_id) AS reviewerName, g.user_id AS ownerPersonnelId, g.region_type AS regionType, g.region_id AS regionId FROM cage_region_grant g LEFT JOIN personnel p ON p.id = g.user_id WHERE g.grant_role = #{grantRole} ORDER BY reviewerName ASC, g.region_type ASC, g.region_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT region_type AS regionType, region_id AS regionId FROM cage_region_grant WHERE region_type IN ('CAMPUS', 'FLOOR', 'ROOM') ORDER BY region_type ASC, region_id ASC
